**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 336 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Deity** [Mugura and Nrithu](/Deities.aspx?ID=300) **Range** 120 feet **Area** 10-foot burst **Defense** Will **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- You create a cloud of mesmerizing patterns and colors that hovers in the air. Creatures are [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) while inside the cloud. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the cloud when you cast it, when it enters the cloud, when it ends its turn within the cloud, or if it uses a [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) or Interact action on the cloud. A creature currently [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) by _hypnotize_ doesn't attempt new saves. **Success** The target is unaffected.
**Failure** The target is fascinated by the cloud.
**Critical Failure** The target is fascinated by the cloud. While it remains fascinated, it can't use reactions.
